svg.title: Proposed keyed top plugs and bottom input sockets
svg.text: Full fit: why the previous wildcard proposal fails
Top plugs protrude upwards; matching recesses are on the bottom of the next tile.
These are plan views in the same assembly coordinates, not views looking up from underneath.
Input 0/1 cavities copy the corresponding plug profile. C sockets copy only C profiles.
A logical * mask has no full-fit physical realization here. A union cavity cannot implement it.
Vertical fit: aligned section through a 0 connector
Upper tile: input cavity on BOTTOM
Recess accepts the entire protruding profile.
Lower tile: output plug on TOP
Nominal plug volume must equal recess volume once seated.
Exploded vertically for clarity; assembly closes the gap between the two face planes.
Verified FULL-fit matrix: * columns correctly fail
Assumes registered tile positions. Full tile alignment, clearances and printable dimensions remain to be designed.
